headline: CSN Shares Drop 8 Percent Amid Wall Street Sell-Off and Debt Concerns
summary: Brazil’s CSN fell 8.31% for its fifth consecutive loss as a Wall Street sell-off and rising debt fears weighed on steel stocks.
why: Steel producers with significant debt loads are vulnerable to broader equity market downturns and tightening financial conditions.
